**AI/ML & Tech Industry**
The AI startup landscape continues to evolve, with Anthropic surpassing OpenAI to become the most valuable AI startup, sparking discussion in the community. The Pope's encyclical addressing technological messianism has sparked conversation about the ethical implications of rapid tech advancement.
